hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -f docs/STATUS.md ] && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then s=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- docs/STATUS.md 2>/dev/null); c=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- "*.py" "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.js" "*.go" "*.rs" "*.cs" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -n "$c" ] && [ "$c" -gt "$s" ]; then echo "docs/STATUS.md predates the latest source commit — read its numbers with suspicion and update it before relying on them."; fi; fi'

bash -c 'if [ -f docs/STATUS.md ]; then d=$(grep -oE "[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}" docs/STATUS.md | head -1); if [ -n "$d" ]; then ts=$(date -d "$d" +%s 2>/dev/null || date -j -f %Y-%m-%d "$d" +%s 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$ts" ]; then age=$(( ( $(date +%s) - ts ) / 86400 )); if [ "$age" -gt 14 ]; then echo "docs/STATUS.md dates itself $age days ago — verify its claims against reality before trusting them."; fi; fi; fi; fi'

bash -c 'for f in AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then n=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$n" -gt 250 ]; then echo "$f is $n lines — over the 250-line budget. Suggest a refactor session: move detail into docs/ and replace with pointers."; fi; fi; done'

bash -c 'for f in docs/SPEC.md docs/GLOSSARY.md; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then n=$(wc -l < "$f"); if [ "$n" -gt 400 ]; then echo "$f is $n lines — consider splitting: move detail to a sub-doc and replace with a pointer."; fi; fi; done'

bash -c 'if [ -f docs/STATUS.md ]; then n=$(wc -l < docs/STATUS.md); if [ "$n" -gt 150 ]; then echo "docs/STATUS.md is $n lines — it should be a one-screen dashboard. Move dated session narratives and fix logs to docs/CHANGELOG.md."; fi; fi'

bash -c 'for f in AGENTS.md docs/*.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; grep -oE "\`[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\`" "$f" 2>/dev/null | tr -d "\`" | grep -E "^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)+\.[A-Za-z]{1,5}$|^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*/$" | sort -u | while read -r p; do [ -e "$p" ] || echo "$f references $p which does not exist — dead pointers mis-brief agents; fix the reference or the path."; done; done'

bash -c 'if [ -f docs/STATUS.md ] && git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then s=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- docs/STATUS.md 2>/dev/null); c=$(git log -1 --format=%ct -- "*.py" "*.ts" "*.tsx" "*.js" "*.go" "*.rs" "*.cs" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$s" ] && [ -n "$c" ] && [ "$c" -gt "$s" ]; then echo "docs/STATUS.md may be stale — source has been committed since it was last updated."; fi; fi'
